body:
<!-- plain-summary -->
This step turns the whole consistency check into a standing automated job that runs continuously, and converts any problem it uncovers into a permanent fast-running regression test. Data safety isn't a one-time achievement, so this guards against a future change silently reintroducing a way to lose or corrupt data.

**Slice 6 of #329.** The standing job and the learning loop — DoD items 3 and 4.

**Done when:**
- The suite runs green in a **privileged off-Check CI job**, kept out of the unprivileged `cargo xtask ci` (ADR-0016); the harness's host-independent logic is itself unit-tested (the #250 lesson: no inert dispatch scaffolding).
- Any anomaly the checker finds is minimized to a seed and **promoted into DST as a permanent regression** (ADR-0009; the FoundationDB/TigerBeetle pattern).

**Depends on:** #329.5. **Refs:** #329, ADR-0016, ADR-0009.

comments.body: Re-milestoned to **Metadata Store FoundationDB** (M14). Per ADR-0042 the production distributed backend is FoundationDB, so the checked consistency run / public credibility artifact (#408) and the privileged CI + bug→DST loop (this issue) must target the **FDB** cluster, not the soon-to-be-fallback TiKV stack. The backend-agnostic harness pieces — the Elle register/list-append models (#406) and the partition nemesis (#407) — stay in M4 and are reused here. Parent tracker #329.

milestone.description: Step 2. Swap embedded redb for distributed TiKV behind the unchanged MetadataStore trait; multi-key atomic directory ops hold under the distributed store. Completes the single-zone data plane — a soft stopping point, not the release: the ★ Step-2 release point is M8 (proposal 0013 implementation arc, supersedes 0002). Plan: proposal 0015 (supersedes 0007; acceptance PR #417); tracker #201; first-deployment gate #367.
